title: Introduction to Laboratory Chemistry - Chemistry - Qualitative Analysis of Ions
subject: Chemistry

questions.q: In qualitative analysis, Group I cations ($\text{Ag}^+$, $\text{Pb}^{2+}$, $\text{Hg}_2^{2+}$) are separated from a solution by adding which reagent?
questions.explain: Group I cations form insoluble chlorides. Adding **dilute $\text{HCl}$** causes $\text{AgCl}$, $\text{PbCl}_2$, and $\text{Hg}_2\text{Cl}_2$ to precipitate, allowing them to be filtered out from other ions.
